blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures even when response curves differ, and attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with beginning sensitivity in the tested Transformer family. These exploratory results show that effective context use depends on the evaluated architecture family, capability, task, and prompt, without isolating the sequence mixer as the sole cause.
blocks.zh: 长文本模型往往在远离快速边界时使用含答证据的效果较差. 我们比较了变形器、状态空间和混合Mamba架构之间的这种位置偏差, 通过一套固定的9个分散器移动一个金色文件。 被评价的变形金刚显示一个开始的优势,即被评价的状态空间模型缺乏,同时两个家庭都倾向于接近尾声的证据. 与此相对应的纯和假的曼巴比较指向同一方向,但统计上仍然不确定。 家庭差异出现在能够应对任务的模型中. 变形器的首要地位在合成检索中再次出现,其中的状态-空间上限阻止了家庭的比较. 在一个状态-空间架构内进行方块互换,会改变整体准确性,而不发生可察觉的曲线形状变化. 即时变化可以创造或几乎消除开始的优势. 即使在反应曲线不同时,各个架构的位置仍然可以解码,注意力集中在初始信号库附近,在测试过的变形器家族中开始敏感。 这些探索性结果表明,有效上下文的使用取决于评估的架构家族、能力、任务和即时性,而不孤立序列混合器作为唯一原因。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Retrieval can place the right document in a prompt without ensuring that a model will use it.
In multi-document question answering, accuracy often drops when relevant evidence moves from the context edges toward the middle ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
This gap between available and effectively used context matters for retrieval-augmented systems and motivates robust long-context evaluation ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Hsieh et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
检索可以在不保证模型使用的情况下将正确的文档及时放入.
在多文档问答中,当相关证据从上下文边缘向中间移动时,准确性往往会下降(Liu等,2024年)。
现有和有效使用的上下文系统之间的这一差距促使对长文进行评价(Bai等,2024;Hsieh等,2024)。

blocks.en:
Most evidence-position studies focus on Transformers.
Dense attention can mix information directly across token positions, whereas state-space models carry the prefix through recurrent state ( Gu and Dao, 2023 ; Dao and Gu, 2024 ) .
We ask whether these sequence-mixer families exhibit the same position curve.
Across our evaluated systems, they do not.
Transformers favor evidence near the beginning, the tested state-space models lack the same beginning advantage, and both families favor evidence near the end.
The difference emerges only once models can reliably answer the task.
blocks.zh:
大多数证据定位研究都以"变形"为主.
Dense attention可以直接将信息混为一谈地标位置,而状态-空间模型则通过反复状态(Gu and Dao, 2023; Dao and Gu, 2024.
我们询问这些序列混合器家族是否呈现出相同的位置曲线.
在我们评价的系统中,它们没有。
变形人倾向于接近开头的证据,被测试的状态-空间模型缺乏相同的起始优势,两个家庭都倾向于接近结尾的证据.
只有在模型能够可靠地回答任务时,才会出现这种差异.

blocks.en:
The curve is not an architecture-only signature.
A matched hybrid comparison is directionally consistent but uncertain, a corpus swap changes overall accuracy without detectably changing curve shape, and prompt changes can create or nearly erase the beginning advantage.
Internal measurements further suggest that position information can remain available even when it is not used equally across positions.
Our contribution is therefore an evaluation result: long-context position bias varies across the tested sequence-mixer families and evaluation settings, while current evidence does not establish a causal mechanism.
blocks.zh:
曲线不只是一个架构签名 。
相匹配的混合比较在方向上是一致的,但不确定的,一个等离子交换会改变整体的准确性,而不会明显地改变曲线形状,而迅速的改变可以创造或几乎去除开始的优势.
内部测量还表明,即使职位之间没有平等使用职位信息,也可继续提供。
因此,我们的贡献是评价结果:经过测试的序列混合器家族和评价设置中,长文本位置偏差不一,而目前的证据并没有建立因果机制。

blocks.en: 2 Paired position evaluation
blocks.zh: 2个Paired职位评价

blocks.en:
Task We use the released Lost-in-the-Middle ten-document question-answering setting, derived from Natural Questions ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) .
Each question has one gold document and nine distractors.
For every question, we render ten prompts that hold the question, distractors, and token budget fixed while moving only the gold document.
A no-gold prompt measures the floor and a gold-only prompt measures answerability.
All reported ten-document results draw from an 800-question exploratory allocation or a subset; the held-out confirmatory split remains unopened.
blocks.zh:
任务 我们使用发行的Lost-in-the-Middle 10文档问答设置,来源于"自然问题"(Liu等,2024;Kwiatkowski等,2019.
每个问题都有一个金色文件和九个分心器.
对于每一个问题,我们给出十个提示 持有问题,分散注意力, 和象征性预算 固定而只移动黄金文件。
无金快来测量地板,只有金快来量答.
所有报告的10个文件结果都来自800个问题探索性分配或一个子集;搁置的确认分裂仍未打开。

blocks.en:
Metrics and inference Primacy is start-minus-middle accuracy and recency is end-minus-middle accuracy, as defined in Figure 1 .
The question is the unit of analysis.
We draw 10,000 paired bootstrap samples of complete ten-position bundles, report percentile 95% confidence intervals, and apply Holm correction within each comparison family ( Efron, 1979 ; Holm, 1979 ) .
Intervals quantify variation across questions for fixed prompts and checkpoints, not training-seed variation.
Generation is greedy, and the harness preserves prompts, outputs, failures, token counts, model revisions, and software settings.

如图1所定义,量子和推论Primacy是起动-减-中位精度,而Reagency是起动-减-中位精度.
问题在于分析的单位。
我们抽取了10,000对双靴子样本 完整的10个位置包, 报告百分位95%的置信间隔,
相互间对固定提示和检查站问题的差异进行量化,而不是培训种子的差异。
一代人贪婪,而这种用具保存了快感,输出,失败,令牌计数,模型修订,以及软件设置.

blocks.en:
Controls On a 200-question exploratory Transformer subset, a released key-value task produces the expected edge effect, sham-gold primacy is near zero, and permuting distractor order changes mean accuracy by at most 0.023 0.023 .
These controls check the paired harness in that setting only; they do not cover the matched 8B checkpoints.
blocks.zh:
控件 在200个问题探索变形器子集上,一个被放出的关键值任务会产生预期的边缘效应,假金色的首要值接近于零,而活化分心器顺序变化的精确度最高为0.0230.023.
这些管制只检查这种环境中的配对绳;它们没有覆盖相应的8B检查站。

blocks.en: 3 Findings
blocks.zh: 3 调查结果

blocks.en:
Sequence-mixer families differ at usable capability In a shared-corpus comparison at similar scale, the Transformer has a positive primacy edge, while two state-space variants do not; all three have positive recency edges (Figure 2 a).
Paired interactions confirm that the Transformer-versus-state-space primacy differences are unlikely to arise from question sampling alone.
Across five approximate size pairs, the family gap is absent at the two smallest scales, where answerability is poor, and appears in the three larger pairs.
This is a descriptive family-and-capability trend, not a causal scale threshold.
blocks.zh:
序列混合型家庭在可用能力上有所不同 在类似尺度的共享-公司比较中,"变形器"具有正向优先边缘,而两个状态-空间变体没有;所有三个都具有正向备用边缘(图2 a).
帕耶德相互作用证实,仅凭问题取样就不大可能产生变形器与状态空间的首要区别。
在大约五对夫妇中,家庭差距在两个最小的尺度上是不存在的,在两个尺度上,可答性差,出现在三个较大的尺度上。
这是一个描述性的家庭和能力趋势,而不是一个因果尺度门槛。

blocks.en:
The tighter comparison is suggestive, not decisive Pure and hybrid state-space checkpoints share training data, tokenizer, scale, depth, and positional setup; the hybrid adds a minority of attention layers ( Waleffe et al., 2024 ) .
The hybrid shows a larger within-model primacy edge, but the paired hybrid-minus-pure confidence interval includes zero (Figure 2 b).
This direction agrees with the family comparison but does not isolate a causal attention effect.
blocks.zh:
更精确的比较是暗示性的,而不是决定性的纯粹和混合状态-空间检查站共享培训数据、标语、规模、深度和位置设置;混合状态增加了少数关注层(Waleffe等,2024年)。
杂交显示的是更大的模型内的首要边缘,但配对的杂交-最小-纯置信间隔包括0(图2b).
这一方向与家庭比较一致,但并不孤立因果关注效应。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 4. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Mechanism measurements motivate hypotheses Position is linearly decodable from intermediate states in both families relative to shuffled-label controls, even when their response curves differ.
Within the tested Transformer family, attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with primacy across scale ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) .
The probe does not show that answer content is stored or used, scale confounds the attention association, and no valid sink-blocking intervention was completed.
The measurements therefore motivate an evidence-utilization hypothesis but do not establish its mechanism.
blocks.zh:
机制测量激发了假设 相对于被洗涤的标签控制,位置在两个家族的中间状态中都是线性可解码的,即使其反应曲线不同.
在经过测试的变形金刚家族中,注意力集中在最初的标志上,并且具有超乎寻常的地位(Xiao等,2024年)。
探测器没有显示解答内容被存储或使用,尺度混淆了注意力关联,没有完成有效的沉积阻断干预.
因此,这些测量可以促进证据利用假设,但没有确立其机制。

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Exploratory evidence on attention concentration, position decodability, and prompt sensitivity.
The sink and probe measurements are correlational, and the prompt variants change multiple prompt properties rather than isolating one causal mechanism.
blocks.zh:
图 4: 探究关于注意力集中,位置可解码,和即时灵敏度的证据.
水槽和探测器的测量是相互关联的,而即时变体会改变多个即时特性,而不是孤立出一种因果机制.

blocks.en:
Implications The central finding is that available context length and effective evidence use are different properties.
Models with the same ten documents can exhibit distinct position curves, and prompt layout can alter those curves as much as family choice.
Long-context evaluations should therefore report full position curves, hold distractors fixed, use paired question-level inference, and test prompt sensitivity rather than relying on a single aggregate accuracy.
blocks.zh:
影响 中心结论是,现有上下文长度和有效证据使用是不同的属性.
具有相同10个文档的模型可以显示不同的位置曲线,而即时布局可以像家庭选择一样改变这些曲线.
因此,长文评价应报告完整的位置曲线,固定分心器,使用对等的问题层次推论,测试即时灵敏度,而不是依赖单一的总精度。

blocks.en:
Reproducibility The released materials record the dataset split, prompt builder, scorer, greedy inference settings, phase samples, checkpoint revisions, and raw generations for the standard question-answering sweeps.
The primary sweep contains 9,600 generations per system with no reported generation failure or scored null.
The synthetic check lacks raw generations and an environment manifest, and the matched comparison cannot be reconstructed from a recorded clean producing code state.
blocks.zh:
可复制性 所放出的材料记录了数据集分出,即时建立者,计分者,贪婪的推论设置,相位样本,检查点修改,以及用于标准问答扫描的生代.
主扫射每个系统有9600代,没有报告一代失败或得分无效.
合成检查缺乏生代和显示的环境,无法从记录的清洁生产代码状态重建相应的比较。

blocks.en:
Limitations The study is limited to a small set of models, architectures, tasks, and prompts, and all ten-document results are exploratory.
Family comparisons retain differences in depth, positional encoding, state size, and checkpoint construction; the tighter hybrid contrast is uncertain.
The internal evidence is correlational, and the held-out split is unexamined.
blocks.zh:
限制 该研究仅限于一套小的模型,建筑,任务,和提示,所有十大文件的结果都是探索性的.
家庭比较保留了深度、位置编码、州规模和检查站建设等方面的差异;更紧密的混合式对比不确定。
内部证据是相通相通的,被搁置的分出没有经过审查.

blocks.en:
Broader impact Position-sensitive evidence use can make retrieval-augmented systems unreliable and privilege facts because of placement rather than relevance.
Long-context accuracy should not be interpreted as uniform evidence access.
blocks.zh:
对位置敏感的证据的使用可能使检索到的系统不可靠,并由于放置而非相关性而具有特殊性。
长文准确性不应被解释为统一的证据获取.

blocks.en:
Conclusion and future directions Position bias varies across the evaluated sequence-mixer families and settings rather than following one universal long-context curve.
The shared end advantage and family-dependent beginning behavior also show why a single aggregate long-context score is incomplete.
Future work should train matched Transformer, state-space, and hybrid systems under one data and positional setup, then test targeted interventions on how evidence is retained and used.
Preregistered evaluation on the held-out questions is needed to confirm the present exploratory results.
Extending paired position curves to longer contexts, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-step tasks would test whether these patterns predict downstream reliability.
blocks.zh:
结论和今后的方向 位置偏差因所评价的序列混合器家族和设置而异,而不是遵循一个通用的长文本曲线.
共享的终极优势和依赖家庭的起步行为也显示了单项汇总长篇小说得分不完全的原因.
今后的工作应在一个数据和位置设置下培训匹配的变换器、状态空间和混合系统,然后测试如何保留和使用证据的有针对性的干预措施。
需要对搁置的问题进行预先登记的评价,以确认目前的探讨结果。
将配对位置曲线扩展至较长的上下文,取回-增强生成,以及多步骤任务,将测试这些模式是否预测下游可靠性.

The pure model’s primacy edge is + 0.008 +0.008 with CI [ − 0.009 , 0.024 ] [-0.009,0.024] , and the hybrid’s is + 0.027 +0.027 with CI [ 0.008 , 0.047 ] [0.008,0.047] .
The paired hybrid-minus-pure primacy effect is + 0.019 +0.019 with CI [ − 0.006 , 0.044 ] [-0.006,0.044] and Holm p = 0.144 p=0.144 .
The paired recency effect is − 0.028 -0.028 with CI [ − 0.055 , − 0.001 ] [-0.055,-0.001] and Holm p = 0.089 p=0.089 .
The paired interaction is the relevant architecture test; different within-model significance levels do not establish a between-model difference.
A.5 Capability and scale
blocks.zh: A.5 能力和规模

blocks.en:
Figure 6: Primacy across five approximate Transformer-state-space size pairs.
The family gap is visible only among models that can answer the task, so the trend combines capability and family.
blocks.zh:
图 6:Primacy横跨5个相近的变形器-状态-空间大小对.
家庭差距只在能够应对任务的模型中可见,因此趋势是能力与家庭相结合的.

blocks.en:
Across the five pairs, the Transformer-minus-state-space primacy gap is near zero at the two smallest scales and is + 0.062 +0.062 , + 0.069 +0.069 , and + 0.053 +0.053 in the three larger pairs.
The smallest Transformer ceiling is only 0.009 0.009 , which prevents interpretation as a depth threshold or causal scale transition.
blocks.zh:
横跨五对,变形器-减-状态-空间优先级差距在两个最小的尺度上接近于零,为+0.062+0.062,+0.069+0.069,而三对较大的尺度上为+0.053+0.053.
最小的变形器上限只有0.009 0.009,这阻止了作为深度阈值或因果尺度过渡的解释.

blocks.en: A.6 Corpus and task checks
blocks.zh: A.6 公司和任务检查

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Fixed architecture with two training corpora.
The corpus swap changes overall accuracy without a detectable edge-shape change.
blocks.zh:
图7:两所培训公司固定建筑。
生物体交换改变了整体准确性,没有可探测到的边缘形状变化。

blocks.en:
Figure 8: Primacy and recency on multi-document QA and synthetic retrieval.
The synthetic task reproduces Transformer primacy but leaves the state-space systems at ceiling.
blocks.zh:
图8:多文件QA和合成检索的优先性和惯性。
合成任务复制了"变形器"的首要性,但将状态-空间系统留在了天花板上.

blocks.en:
Holding the state-space architecture fixed, the Pile-minus-SlimPajama primacy effect is − 0.007 -0.007 with CI [ − 0.030 , 0.016 ] [-0.030,0.016] and the recency effect is − 0.016 -0.016 with CI [ − 0.044 , 0.012 ] [-0.044,0.012] .
On 50 RULER single-needle examples at 2K tokens, Transformer primacy is + 0.12 +0.12 with CI [ 0.05 , 0.20 ] [0.05,0.20] , while both state-space models score 1.0 1.0 at every tested depth.
Raw generations and an environment manifest for this synthetic check are not available in the repository snapshot.
blocks.zh:
持有已固定的状态-空间架构,Pile-minus-SlimPajama优先效应为-0.007-0.007与CI [-0.030,0.016] [-0.030,0.016] 复用效应为-0.016-0.016与CI [-0.044,0.012] [-0.044,0.012].
在2K令牌的50个RULAR单需要例上,"变形器"优先级为+0.12+0.12与CI [0.05,0.20] [0.05,0.20],而两种状态-空间模型在每次测试深度时均得分1.0.
原始世代和这种合成检查所显示的环境在仓库快照中没有。

blocks.en: A.7 Prompt and internal measurements
blocks.zh: A.7 迅速和内部测量

blocks.en:
On 200 exploratory questions, repeating the question before and after the documents changes state-space primacy from 0.000 0.000 to + 0.103 +0.103 .
Placing the question only before the documents yields primacy of + 0.020 +0.020 and reduces recency from + 0.070 +0.070 to + 0.010 +0.010 .
An alternative template reduces Transformer primacy from + 0.070 +0.070 to + 0.005 +0.005 .
A balanced linear probe predicts edge versus middle position above a shuffled-label control in both families, but this does not establish answer-content storage or causal use.
blocks.zh:
在200个探索性问题上,重复文件前后的问题,将状态-空间的首要地位从0.000.000改为+0.103+0.103.103。
仅在文件产生优先度为+0.020+0.020之前提出问题,并降低复读率,从+0.070+0.070被降为+0.010+0.010.
一个可选模板将变形器优先级由+0.070+0.070降低到+0.005+0.005.
一个平衡的线性探测器预测出边缘相对于两个家族中被打乱的标签控制上方的中位位置,但这并不能确定答案-内容存储或因果使用.

blocks.en: A.8 Additional systems
blocks.zh: A.8 其他系统

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Descriptive position curves for three additional Transformer and hybrid systems.
All show positive primacy, but cross-system differences do not isolate architecture.
blocks.zh:
图9:新增三个变形器和混合系统的描述性位置曲线.
都表现出了积极的至高无上,但跨系统差异并不孤立架构.

blocks.en:
The additional systems have primacy edges of + 0.076 +0.076 , + 0.041 +0.041 , and + 0.067 +0.067 .
They differ in architecture, training data, tokenizer, token count, depth, and positional encoding, so the comparison establishes prevalence rather than mechanism.
blocks.zh:
附加的系统有: +0.076+0.076,+0.041+0.041; +0.067+0.067.
它们在架构,培训数据,标注器,符号计数,深度,和位置编码上各不相同,因此比较确定了流行性而非机制.

blocks.en: Appendix B Controls and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 附录B 管制和可复制性

blocks.en:
The released key-value positive control detects a + 0.38 +0.38 edge-versus-middle effect.
On the 200-question exploratory Transformer sample, sham-gold primacy is + 0.005 +0.005 with CI [ − 0.0325 , 0.0425 ] [-0.0325,0.0425] , and distractor-order permutation accuracy has a maximum spread of 0.0233 0.0233 .
These controls certify the paired position harness only in that setting and do not cover the matched 8B checkpoints.
The blinded audit has no human labels, and some control outputs are absent outside the primary setting.
blocks.zh:
被放出的关键值正控能检测出+0.38+0.38的边缘对中效应.
在200个问题探索变形器样本上,假金色优先为+0.005+0.005,与CI [−0.0325,0.0425] [-0.0325,0.0425],分心-顺序振荡精度最大分布为0.0233 0.0233.
这些管制只在这种环境下证明配对位置,而不包括相应的8B检查站。
盲目审计没有人名标签,一些控制产出在主设定之外缺失.

blocks.en:
The repository records the dataset split, prompts, scorer, greedy inference settings, phase samples, model revisions, raw generations for standard QA sweeps, and paired-bootstrap analysis.
The evaluation used the project compute nodes documented with the released artifacts and required at least approximately 50 single-GPU hours, excluding failed runs, reruns, plotting, and development.
blocks.zh:
寄存器记录了数据集的分解,提示,计分器,贪婪的推论设置,相位样本,模型修订,标准QA扫描的生代,以及配对-bootstrap分析.
评价使用与释放的文物一起记录的项目计算出节点,至少需要约50个单GPU小时,不包括故障运行,再运行,密谋,开发.
